patterns.message: packages/shared is engine code and must stay runtime-agnostic. PLAN.md (Multiplayer Readiness: "Engine modules never import from react, pixi.js, or any browser API") forbids React here. Put UI code in packages/app.

packages/shared is engine code and must stay runtime-agnostic. PLAN.md (Multiplayer Readiness: "Engine modules never import from react, pixi.js, or any browser API") forbids PixiJS here. Put rendering code in packages/app/src/renderer or src/editor.

packages/shared is engine code and must stay runtime-agnostic. PLAN.md (Multiplayer Readiness) keeps UI state out of the engine; the engine talks to the page only through SimTransport. Put stores in packages/app/src/store.

packages/shared must not import from packages/app (#/*, @/* or @rail-op-sim/app). PLAN.md (Multiplayer Readiness) requires the engine to run with no app code. Move the shared logic into packages/shared instead.
packages/app/src/renderer is pure rendering code and must not import from store/, editor/, or components/. Pass state or callbacks in via explicit parameters or context instead.
packages/app/src/store holds application state and must not import from editor/ or renderer/. Move shared constants or helpers into packages/app/src/lib instead.
